checks.name: the tab opens a shell in the chat's working folder on the chosen engine
TERM is xterm-256color and the shell's width is the pane's
the pty follows the pane: tput cols shrinks with the window
an interactive prompt (read -p) is answered as it waits
an ANSI red sequence is rendered, not printed

detail.note: the buffer text reads RED-TEXT plain with no escape bytes

checks.name: Ctrl+C interrupts a running command and the prompt returns
less takes the alternate screen and q gives the main screen back
⌘F opens find in the terminal and Escape returns to the shell
the assistant's commands mirror into the strip under the terminal and survive the shell's next output
both themes hand the emulator plain colours, and a live theme change repaints
Restart stops the shell with verification and opens a new one

limits: One Mac, the login shell of this account, under Electron from source.
